title: Control State Record
description: Machine-readable record generated at loop completion stating the verdict on every required control. Distinct from the evidence bundle (which contains the artefacts that constitute the evidence): this record contains the structured verdict layer. Enables a release layer to assess gate readiness programmatically and route only exceptions to humans. Implements the verdict and waiver model in manifesto.md (What the Loop Produces — Control state record). STATUS: DRAFT — governance-authority signoff required.

loop_iteration_id.description: Joins to the evidence bundle and the agentic provenance record for the same loop iteration.

generated_at.description: Generated at loop completion, not assembled post-hoc.

evidence_bundle_id.description: Reference to the companion evidence bundle envelope.

controls.description: Per-control verdicts. Every required control for the work item class must appear in this array.

verdict.description: passed = control evaluated and met; failed = control evaluated and not met; waived = control bypassed under explicit, expiring waiver; stale = artefact required by the control is outside its freshness window; needs-decision = a human judgment is required before the gate can be assessed.

evidence_reference.description: Pointer into the evidence bundle (e.g., trace ID, report path, artefact hash).

waiver.description: Required when verdict='waived'. The waiver lapses at expiry_date and the control reverts to required.

rationale.description: Why the waiver was granted for this control on this iteration.

granted_by.description: Name of the human who granted the waiver. Not an agent.

expiry_date.description: Date after which the waiver lapses and the control reverts to required.
